name: Cordless 2-in-1 Straightening Comb
tagline: Straighten or curl anywhere. No cord, heats up in about a minute.
bullets: Straightens and curls in one tool
4 heat settings with an LED display
specs: Heat settings: 4 (about 140 to 200 °C). Battery: rechargeable, USB-C cable included. Heat-up time: about 60 seconds. In the box: comb, USB-C cable, instructions.
howToUse: Charge fully before first use. Brush through dry, detangled hair in small sections, starting on the lowest heat. To curl, twist the comb as you pull it down. Works on most hair types. Keep away from water and let it cool before packing it away.

name: Galaxy Star Projector
tagline: Turns your ceiling into a nebula.
bullets: Nebula and star modes with 8 colours
specs: Power: USB-C, 5 V. Modes: nebula, stars, both. Timer: 1 or 2 hours. In the box: projector, remote, USB-C cable.
howToUse: Plug in, point at the ceiling and pick a mode with the remote. Best in a dark room, 1 to 3 metres from the wall.

name: Portable Blender Bottle
bullets: 400 ml bottle with 6 stainless steel blades
Blades lock unless the lid is on
specs: Capacity: 400 ml. Blades: 6, stainless steel. Charging: USB-C, about 3 hours for a full charge.
howToUse: Add liquid first, then fruit or ice in small pieces. Close the lid, press the button twice and blend for 30 to 40 seconds. Rinse with warm water and a drop of soap.

name: Oversized Heavyweight Tee
tagline: Boxy fit, thick cotton, never see-through.
bullets: Size down for a regular fit
specs: Fabric: 280 gsm 100% cotton jersey. Fit: oversized and boxy. Chest width S 56 cm, M 58 cm, L 61 cm, XL 64 cm.
howToUse: Machine wash cold, inside out. Tumble dry low or hang dry to keep the shape.
